intro.text: The leader of a band of Tukari mercenaries who attacked the honorspren Notum and fought Adolin Kholin.

items.text: The Tukari leader and his men fell on Notum after the honorspren went south on patrol. When Adolin came to Notum's aid, the leader stayed out of the fighting and gave orders, and his command kept his men in the fight after Adolin's first charge instead of letting them scatter.

He lost his hold on the mercenaries once Maya joined the battle. Adolin slipped past his bodyguard and struck at him, but he dodged at the last instant and took only a cut across the shoulder. He then pulled back to the caravan with his surviving men, and they left the area.

appearance.text: Probably Makabaki, with brown skin and black hair, he dresses in the style of southeastern Makabak, including a patterned overcoat in blue on yellow. His features are hard to make out, perhaps by some supernatural means.
